name: web-logistics-company-site-in-grey-green-with-container-photos-and-industry-cards
title: Sage-green board of four logistics pages: container hero, solutions photo cards, industry cards with one dark, and technology list
whatItIs: A sage-green board with four white page windows: a hero 'Let's Move Your Business Forward' with a black button and a photo of green and white shipping containers, 'Logistics Solutions' with a bento of photo cards with captions, 'Tailored Logistics for Every Business' with four industry cards where one is dark, and 'Innovation that Moves Your Business' with a container photo and four feature blocks with arrow circles.
whatItMeans: Clean and reliable; muted green matches the containers and black buttons keep it serious.
techniques: Match the palette to the brand's containers.
Use dark gradient captions on photo cards.
Highlight one industry card in dark grey.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of photo cards with different sizes.
A card naming a sector with an icon.
